messages:
opsbot: INCIDENT P1 — Dedicated GPU pool (eu-west-1) degradation affecting customer: Fulcrum (enterprise-fulcrum). Error rate up ~18% 5xx, p95 latency doubled. Paging @josh_oncall. Runbook: dedicated-fallback. https://internal/alerts/1809993333 :rotating_light:

josh_oncall: Acknowledged. Jumping in now. Anyone seen recent deploys or autoscaler events?

sanjay_infra: No deploys in the last 30m. I see repeated OOM restarts on node-gpu-07 and autoscaler is briefly scaling down then up — looks like flapping. Logs show repeated kernel OOM at 23:09:12 UTC.

lee_sre: If node OOMs, we should drain and restart the pool. Can we scale dedicated pool to standby capacity and route traffic to fallback model variant (cpu-quantized) in the meantime? That reduces risk of full outage.

josh_oncall: Good call. Initiating drain on node-gpu-07 and bumping pool target +20% for standby. Also creating canary route to cpus-quant for Fulcrum org only.

pagerduty-bot: Paging: @josh_oncall has acknowledged the incident. Severity: P1. Escalation timer paused.

marta_csm: Thumbsup — I'll prepare the Fulcrum-specific customer notification. Draft below, please review and approve for send.

marta_csm: ```Hi <Fulcrum primary>,
We’re investigating elevated errors and latency affecting Fulcrum’s dedicated inference pool in eu-west-1. You may see intermittent request failures (~18% 5xx) and slower responses. Our remediation plan: draining affected hosts, temporarily routing traffic to a fallback model variant, and increasing pool capacity. We expect reduced errors within 30–45 minutes.
We’ll update you again in 30 minutes or as we have material changes. If you need immediate help, reply on this thread or contact me directly at marta@redwood.ai.
Best, Marta (Redwood Customer Success)```

incident_manager: Approved to send as soon as @josh_oncall confirms routing is in place. Add a short blurb for the public status page: "Dedicated inference degraded for select enterprise customers in eu-west-1; mitigation in progress; targeted notifications sent."

josh_oncall: Canary routing active to cpu-quant for Fulcrum at 23:14 UTC, traffic shifted ~15%. Draining node-gpu-07 now. Monitoring errors.

sanjay_infra: Drained node-gpu-07 and restarted. Kernel OOM root cause looks like a recent batch job saturated GPU memory (job id: job-7824). I'm isolating the job and adding stricter resource limits to batch queue.

lee_sre: Monitoring shows error rate falling to ~6% and p95 back down to 1.8x baseline. Good progress but watch for reoccurrence while autoscaler policy heals.

marta_csm: Sending tailored email to Fulcrum primary and secondary now. Copying incident status page blurb to internal comms.

incident_manager: Internal comms template for account-team: please use the following snippet when speaking to Fulcrum stakeholders:

```Redwood internal: Fulcrum (enterprise-fulcrum) — Impact: intermittent 5xx and elevated latency on dedicated eu-west-1 pool between 23:08–23:35 UTC. Mitigation: drained affected host, increased pool capacity, routed to cpu-quant fallback for the org. Action items: CS to notify primary + secondary, SRE to monitor for reoccurrence and validate autoscaler fixes, Infra to hard-limit batch jobs on GPU hosts. Owner: @marta_csm (customer comms), @lee_sre (SRE), @sanjay_infra (infra).```

josh_oncall: Passing on-call to @lee_sre for ongoing monitoring — I need to jump to a separate P0. Lee, current state: errors trending down, fallback in place, node restarted, autoscaler flapping addressed by tightening scale-down threshold.

lee_sre: Taking over on-call. I'll keep the monitoring dashboard open and coordinate with Infra for post-incident RCA. Please add any missed contacts to the notify list.

marta_csm: Fulcrum contacts notified: primary=alice@fulcrum.com, secondary=ops@fulcrum.com, legal=legal@fulcrum.com. Sent message and confirmation from primary received: "Thanks for the quick update, we see fewer failures."

sanjay_infra: Noted batch job id job-7824 was the immediate trigger. I've put in a short-term policy change to prevent GPU batch-saturation and opened INC-7824 for long-term fix.

incident_manager: Nice work. Please update the status page now with the customer-specific blurb and mark "mitigation in progress". We'll move to "resolved" after 1hr of stable metrics and a short RCA doc attached.

lee_sre: Status page updated at 23:37 UTC. Monitoring for 1hr. Scheduling RCA meeting tomorrow 10:00 UTC.

marta_csm: Final note for the thread: customer impact snippet for account teams (paste into CS ticket): "Fulcrum experienced intermittent request failures and higher latency due to GPU host memory saturation. Mitigation included draining affected hosts, routing to a fallback model variant, and increasing capacity. Customer-facing update sent; they report improved experience." :white_check_mark: 

opsbot: INCIDENT UPDATE — severity reduced to P2 at 23:42 UTC (errors stabilized). Next: RCA and postmortem.

lee_sre: Closing handoff — I'll file RCA notes in INC-7824 and ping stakeholders when posted. Thanks everyone."
